situation: Pre-commit mypy failed on Lightning tests that treat configure_optimizers as a dict.
problem: Lightning types configure_optimizers as a wide OptimizerLRScheduler union, so string-key access and the in operator are rejected.
successful_approach: Annotate the module with OptimizerLRSchedulerConfig and type build_scheduler as LRSchedulerConfigType, which is the mapping the code already returns.
evidence: uv run mypy reported Success on five source files; CUDA-venv pytest passed six tests; ruff and xenon were clean.
reusable_lesson: When Lightning exposes a union, type the actual returned TypedDict at the producer instead of adding type ignore in tests.
avoid: Silencing the union with type ignore or indexing OptimizerLRScheduler as if every variant were a dict.
applicability: Python Lightning modules whose configure_optimizers always returns optimizer and lr_scheduler keys.
